project_type: Foundry Solidity smart-contract protocol: bonding-curve launchpad, Uniswap v4 hook, cross-chain (Monad<->Solana) migration doorway. Handles ETH and protocol fees.
test_framework: forge-std (forge test), unit/integration/fuzz/invariant suites under test/
verification_instructions: Primary success criterion: `forge build --force` must complete with ZERO warnings. Then run `forge test` and confirm no regressions (some fixes add events / reorder nonReentrant modifiers, which can affect behavior). Use --force because forge skips recompile when nothing changed, which hides warnings. Count warnings with: forge build --force 2>&1 | grep -cE '^warning\['. There is NO [lint] section in foundry.toml, so `forge lint` uses defaults; the warnings come from `forge build`'s built-in linter.
snapshot_or_generated_files: out/ and cache/ are build artifacts (gitignored, regenerated by forge build). No checked-in snapshots relevant to this task.
setup_instructions: Dependencies are vendored under lib/ (forge-std, openzeppelin-contracts, v4-core, v4-periphery). No install step needed; forge build works out of the box. Working dir is the Foundry root.
environment_constraints: via_ir = true and optimizer enabled; builds are slower (~minutes). evm_version = cancun. Do NOT commit or push - leave changes in the working tree. Branch feat/vendor-v2-rebrand already has extensive staged rebrand work.
contribution_requirements: This is a vendor-v2 rebrand branch. Files were renamed from src/v2/RetroPickV2* to src/RetroPick*V1. Preserve existing intentional design and existing justification comments. Do NOT change contract behavior except where a warning identifies a genuine bug/improvement.
relevant_files: src/RetroPickGraduationGuardV1.sol (unsafe-typecast line 34 - already documented false positive)
src/RetroPickLaunchFactoryV1.sol (boolean-cst, reentrancy-events/balance, non-reentrant-not-first, unused-return, arbitrary-send-eth, block-timestamp, calls-loop, unsafe-typecast)
src/hooks/RetroPickMemeHookV1.sol (boolean-cst, unsafe-typecast, reentrancy-events/no-eth, non-reentrant-not-first, unused-return, uninitialized-local, divide-before-multiply, missing-zero-check)
.agents/tasks/task-resolve-forge-lint-warnings/warnings_inventory.txt (full list of all 93 warnings with file:line:col)
directory_structure: src/ (core contracts), src/hooks/ (Uniswap v4 hook), src/interfaces/, src/libraries/ (curve/graduation math), test/{unit,integration,fuzz,invariant,mocks}, lib/ (vendored deps), foundry.toml, remappings.txt
